title: Account Nickname (request)
description: Request for the GET /account/v1/nickname endpoint. Requires the Authorization header, plus Deriv-App-ID when authenticating with a Personal Access Token (PAT); takes no query parameters or body. The caller's brand and identity are resolved by the gateway from the X-Brand and X-Client-ID request headers and cannot be spoofed by the client.

Deriv-App-ID.description: Application identifier. Required for Personal Access Token (PAT) authentication; not required for OAuth Bearer tokens.
